create_visualizer_instance: create a Visualizer instance with an opt object to manage training visualization and logging
display_current_results: display current training results by saving images to tensorboard and updating the HTML webpage
plot_current_errors: plot current training errors to tensorboard by writing summary values for each error metric
print_current_errors: print current training errors to console and append them to the loss log file
save_images: save images to disk by writing them to the webpage image directory with labels
